semantic_fixtures.covers: The death trigger captures the exact card and battlefield generation before the event moves it to its next graveyard generation.
The registered card has the exact Mimic Vat identity and complete card definition.
The controller may exile a nontoken creature card that died under either player's control, and a successful new imprint returns the prior linked card.
The typed Exile receipt excludes the exact newly linked event object from ReturnOther while the previous linked card returns to its owner.
Event-card-owner concession invalidates stale accept on the unchanged live chooser prompt; decline remains actionable and preserves the prior link.
The source owner's departure does not invalidate the live controller's suspended imprint choice or rebind its exact event.
Replaying the accepted exact prompt ID produces identical state and event receipt, returns the old link, and keeps the new event card linked.
A departed controller's optional imprint cost is unpaid under CR 800.4f; the event stays in its graveyard and the prior link stays in Exile without a delegate prompt.
An activation queued while Savannah Lions is linked copies the Grizzly Bears linked before resolution, even after Mimic Vat leaves the battlefield.
Declining a later imprint leaves the currently linked card in Exile and the new event card in its graveyard.
A death trigger cannot substitute a later zone incarnation after the exact event card leaves its graveyard; the prior linked card stays exiled.
A commander death triggers Mimic Vat before its owner may move it from the graveyard to the command zone as a state-based action; the departed commander is not imprinted at resolution.
Token creature deaths do not create an imprint trigger.
Two simultaneous creature deaths create independent triggers that retain the source's exact linked-exile pair after it leaves.
One Nevinyrral's Disk resolution destroys Mimic Vat and both observed creatures together; the death triggers still resolve from last-known source information.
An empty linked record creates no token; after an imprint, the token copies the current linked card, gains haste, and is exiled at the next end step.
Mimic Vat can imprint an instant manifested as a face-down creature, but its activation creates no token from that nonpermanent linked card.
A nontoken artifact that died while animated can be imprinted as a noncreature artifact, and its token copy still receives haste.
A token created after the current end step began waits for the following turn's end step before exile.
A copied card's suspended as-enters choice completes before the exact token receives haste and enters the delayed-exile cohort.
Doubling Season's extra token receives haste and one delayed ability exiles every still-current member of the cohort.
Countering the one delayed cohort trigger leaves both tokens and their haste in place and releases the cohort state.
A copied Mimic Vat keeps an independent linked card while the original Vat replaces its own linked card; each later activation copies its own exact link.
